description: Gate every completion claim behind executed evidence. Use before saying "done", "fixed", "works", "passing", "delivered", or "merge-ready" — for any code change, bug fix, refactor, or configuration change. Requires running the relevant command and observing the output in this session; code inspection alone never counts as verification.
